title: refactor(web): type the repository draft as the pack contract
body:
First step of the repository panel (CL-XXXX). The panel's draft is now the pack contract itself plus the four policy fields, so what is loaded is what is saved.

- `pack-draft.ts` replaces the catalog and draft modules: pure edits for catalog checks (only changed keys, a check switched on then off restores the saved row), custom checks (removing one also detaches it from actions, refused when an action would be left with no checks), actions (upsert, remove, move) and roles; a change count from a deep diff of the contract JSON, so actions and order now count; validation that keeps the pack reader's message and maps it to the row it belongs to, plus role targets must exist and triage on needs a check.
- The loader, the writer and the backlog start keep the reader's reason, so a corrupt or invalid pack shows why instead of "not valid".
- The existing panel edits through the new module with the same sections and wording; the old modules and their tests are deleted.

Verified: `bun run check`; web tests, including a byte-identical round trip of the recommended pack and a pack with no optional keys through every catalog toggle, every Do target and action form, change counting, and detaching a removed custom check.

Refs CL-XXXX
